description: Saves the documents of a US mark's file that a type code (from mark_documents) and a date window pick, as one PDF in the server's outbox, and answers its path, SHA-256 and size. Without a filter it is the whole file, which for an old mark runs to hundreds of pages. USPTO allows 4 of these a minute.

from.description: Only documents dated on or after this day.

id.description: The USPTO serial number (8 digits), as search_marks lists it.

office.description: US: case files come from USPTO's TSDR; other offices say where to read them.

to.description: Only documents dated on or before this day.

type.description: A document type code from mark_documents, e.g. "OOA" (an office action).

name: download_mark_documents

path.description: The PDF in the server's outbox

title: Save a mark's documents as a PDF
